    Find the top 10 GitHub users who have the highest proportion of their stars given to repositories owned by 'javisantana' compared to all other repositories they've starred. Show each user's name, the number of stars they gave to javisantana's repos, the number of stars they gave to other repos, and the ratio of javisantana stars to total stars.

DESCRIPTION >

Show each user's name, the number of stars they gave to javisantana's repos, the number of stars they gave to other repos, and the ratio of javisantana stars to total stars.

sql:
SELECT
    bucket_floor AS star_power_of_10,
    count() AS num_repositories
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN count() >= 10000000 THEN 10000000
            WHEN count() >= 1000000 THEN 1000000
            WHEN count() >= 100000 THEN 100000
            WHEN count() >= 10000 THEN 10000
            WHEN count() >= 1000 THEN 1000
            WHEN count() >= 100 THEN 100
            WHEN count() >= 10 THEN 10
            WHEN count() >= 1 THEN 1
        END AS bucket_floor
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY repo_name
) AS repo_star_buckets
GROUP BY bucket_floor
ORDER BY bucket_floor ASC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  repo_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' THEN actor_login END) AS stars_2016,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' THEN actor_login END) AS stars_2017,
  (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' THEN actor_login END) * 1.0 / 
   COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' THEN actor_login END) - 1) * 100 AS growth_yoy
FROM 
  github_events
WHERE 
  event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  AND created_at BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
  AND repo_name IN (
    SELECT 
      repo_name
    FROM 
      github_events
    WHERE 
      event_type = 'WatchEvent'
      AND created_at BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2017-12-31'
    GROUP BY 
      repo_name
    HAVING 
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31' THEN actor_login END) > 0
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN created_at BETWEEN '2017-01-01' AND '2017-12-31' THEN actor_login END) > 0
  )
GROUP BY 
  repo_name
ORDER BY 
  growth_yoy DESC
LIMIT 10

    repo_name, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT IF(toYear(created_at) = 2017, actor_login, NULL)) as num_stars_2017,

sql:
SELECT bucket, count() AS repo_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    repo_name,
    countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') AS star_count,
    CASE
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 10 AND 99 THEN 10
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 100 AND 999 THEN 100
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN 1000
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 10000 AND 99999 THEN 10000
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') BETWEEN 100000 AND 999999 THEN 100000
      WHEN countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent') >= 1000000 THEN 1000000
      ELSE 0
    END AS bucket
  FROM github_events
  GROUP BY repo_name
)
WHERE bucket > 0
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
LIMIT 10

question.name: pipe_09.pipe
question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    Find the top 10 GitHub users who have the highest proportion of their stars given to repositories owned by 'javisantana' compared to all other repositories they've starred. Show each user's name, the number of stars they gave to javisantana's repos, the number of stars they gave to other repos, and the ratio of javisantana stars to total stars.

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    WITH repo_name IN
    (
        SELECT repo_name
        FROM github_events
        WHERE (event_type = 'WatchEvent') AND (actor_login IN ('javisantana'))
    ) AS is_my_repo
    SELECT
        actor_login,
        sum(is_my_repo) AS stars_my,
        sum(NOT is_my_repo) AS stars_other,
        round(stars_my / (stars_my + stars_other), 3) AS ratio
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY actor_login
    ORDER BY ratio DESC
    LIMIT 10

        repo_name,
        COUNT(*) AS stars_2016
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'

    GROUP BY repo_name

stars_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        repo_name,
        COUNT(*) AS stars_2017
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent' 
        AND toYear(created_at) = 2017
    GROUP BY repo_name

    s2017.repo_name,
    s2016.stars_2016,
    s2017.stars_2017,
    s2017.stars_2017 - s2016.stars_2016 AS absolute_growth,
    round((s2017.stars_2017 - s2016.stars_2016) / s2016.stars_2016 * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM stars_2017 s2017
INNER JOIN stars_2016 s2016 ON s2017.repo_name = s2016.repo_name
WHERE s2016.stars_2016 >= 1
ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC

question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    top 10 Repositories with the worst stagnation in 2017 vs 2016. Repos with at least one star in 2017

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    WITH toYear(created_at) AS year
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        sum(year = 2017) AS stars2017,
        sum(year = 2016) AS stars2016,
        round((stars2017 - stars2016) / stars2016 * 100, 2) as yoy
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY repo_name
    HAVING (stars2017 >= 1)
    ORDER BY yoy ASC
    LIMIT 10

TYPE endpoint

SELECT 
    repo_name,
    countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent' AND toYear(created_at) = 2016) AS stars_2016,
    countIf(event_type = 'WatchEvent' AND toYear(created_at) = 2017) AS stars_2017,
    stars_2016 - stars_2017 AS star_decline,
    round((stars_2016 - stars_2017) * 100.0 / stars_2016, 2) AS decline_percentage
FROM github_events
WHERE 
    event_type = 'WatchEvent' 
    AND toYear(created_at) IN (2016, 2017)
GROUP BY repo_name
HAVING 
    stars_2017 >= 1 
    AND stars_2016 > stars_2017
ORDER BY decline_percentage DESC
LIMIT 10

question.name: pipe_15.pipe
question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    top 10 Repositories with the most steady star growth rate over time

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        max(stars) AS daily_stars,
        sum(stars) AS total_stars,
        total_stars / daily_stars AS rate
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            repo_name,
            toDate(created_at) AS day,
            count() AS stars
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY
            repo_name,
            day
    )
    GROUP BY repo_name
    ORDER BY rate DESC
    LIMIT 10

TYPE endpoint

        arrayJoin(labels) AS label,

    FROM github_events
    WHERE (event_type IN ('IssuesEvent', 'PullRequestEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent')) AND (action IN ('created', 'opened', 'labeled'))
    GROUP BY label
    ORDER BY c DESC
    LIMIT 10

DESCRIPTION >
    top 10 Organizations by the size of community (get the organization name from the repo_name)
    return the organization name, the number of unique authors, the number of unique pull request authors, the number of unique issue authors, the number of unique issue comment authors, and the number of unique push authors.

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    SELECT
        lower(substring(repo_name, 1, position(repo_name, '/'))) AS org,
        uniq(actor_login) AS authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PullRequestEvent') AS pr_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'IssuesEvent') AS issue_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'IssueCommentEvent') AS comment_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PullRequestReviewCommentEvent') AS review_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PushEvent') AS push_authors
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('PullRequestEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent', 'PullRequestReviewCommentEvent', 'PushEvent')
    GROUP BY org
    ORDER BY authors DESC
    LIMIT 10

TYPE endpoint

DESCRIPTION >
    top 10 Organizations by the size of community (get the organization name from the repo_name)
    return the organization name, the number of unique authors, the number of unique pull request authors, the number of unique issue authors, the number of unique issue comment authors, and the number of unique push authors.

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    SELECT
        lower(substring(repo_name, 1, position(repo_name, '/'))) AS org,
        uniq(actor_login) AS authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PullRequestEvent') AS pr_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'IssuesEvent') AS issue_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'IssueCommentEvent') AS comment_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PullRequestReviewCommentEvent') AS review_authors,
        uniqIf(actor_login, event_type = 'PushEvent') AS push_authors
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('PullRequestEvent', 'IssuesEvent', 'IssueCommentEvent', 'PullRequestReviewCommentEvent', 'PushEvent')
    GROUP BY org
    ORDER BY authors DESC
    LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN star_count = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN star_count >= 1 AND star_count < 10 THEN 1
        WHEN star_count >= 10 AND star_count < 100 THEN 10
        WHEN star_count >= 100 AND star_count < 1000 THEN 100
        WHEN star_count >= 1000 AND star_count < 10000 THEN 1000
        WHEN star_count >= 10000 AND star_count < 100000 THEN 10000
        WHEN star_count >= 100000 AND star_count < 1000000 THEN 100000
        ELSE 1000000
    END AS power_of_10,
    count(DISTINCT repo_name) AS repo_count
FROM (

        count(*) AS star_count

)

    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            repo_name AS k,
            count() AS c
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY k
    )
    GROUP BY stars
    ORDER BY stars ASC

SELECT 
    t1.repo_name, 
    t1.star_count_2017,
    t2.star_count_2016,
    (t1.star_count_2017 - t2.star_count_2016) as growth
FROM 
    (SELECT repo_name, COUNT(*) as star_count_2017
     FROM github_events
     WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
     AND created_at >= '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
     AND created_at < '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
     GROUP BY repo_name) t1
INNER JOIN 
    (SELECT repo_name, COUNT(*) as star_count_2016
     FROM github_events
     WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
     AND created_at >= '2016-01-01 00:00:00'
     AND created_at < '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
     GROUP BY repo_name) t2
ON t1.repo_name = t2.repo_name
WHERE t2.star_count_2016 >= 1 
AND (t1.star_count_2017 - t2.star_count_2016) > 0
ORDER BY growth DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH star_counts AS (
  SELECT
    repo_name,

  FROM github_events
  WHERE event_type = 15  -- WatchEvent
  GROUP BY repo_name
),
power_definitions AS (
  SELECT 0 AS power, 1 AS power_of_10, 0 AS lower, 1 AS upper UNION ALL
  SELECT 1 AS power, 10 AS power_of_10, 9 AS lower, 11 AS upper UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS power, 100 AS power_of_10, 90 AS lower, 110 AS upper UNION ALL

  SELECT 4 AS power, 10000 AS power_of_10, 9000 AS lower, 11000 AS upper UNION ALL

),
counted AS (
  SELECT
    pd.power,
    pd.power_of_10,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.repo_name) AS repo_count
  FROM
    power_definitions pd
  JOIN
    star_counts sc ON sc.star_count BETWEEN pd.lower AND pd.upper
  GROUP BY
    pd.power, pd.power_of_10
)
SELECT
  power,
  power_of_10,
  repo_count
FROM counted

sql:
SELECT
  stars_bucket,
  count() repositories
FROM
(
  SELECT
    repo_name,
    count() AS star_cnt,
    CASE
      WHEN count() < 10 THEN 1
      WHEN count() < 100 THEN 10
      WHEN count() < 1000 THEN 100
      WHEN count() < 10000 THEN 1000
      WHEN count() < 100000 THEN 10000
      WHEN count() < 1000000 THEN 100000
      WHEN count() < 10000000 THEN 1000000
      WHEN count() < 100000000 THEN 10000000
      WHEN count() < 1000000000 THEN 100000000
      ELSE 1000000000
    END AS stars_bucket
  FROM github_events
  WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  GROUP BY repo_name
)
GROUP BY stars_bucket
ORDER BY stars_bucket
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    repo_name,
    count(*) AS total_stars,
    min(created_at) AS first_star,
    max(created_at) AS last_star,
    uniq(DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)) AS active_months,
    ((YEAR(last_star) - YEAR(first_star)) * 12 + (MONTH(last_star) - MONTH(first_star)) + 1) AS total_months,
    active_months / total_months AS steadiness,
    total_stars / total_months AS avg_monthly_growth
FROM github_events
WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent' AND action = 'started'
GROUP BY repo_name
HAVING total_stars > 100 AND total_months > 12 AND steadiness > 0.8
ORDER BY avg_monthly_growth DESC
LIMIT 10

question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    Find the top 10 GitHub users who have the highest proportion of their stars given to repositories owned by 'javisantana' compared to all other repositories they've starred. Show each user's name, the number of stars they gave to javisantana's repos, the number of stars they gave to other repos, and the ratio of javisantana stars to total stars.

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    WITH repo_name IN
    (
        SELECT repo_name
        FROM github_events
        WHERE (event_type = 'WatchEvent') AND (actor_login IN ('javisantana'))
    ) AS is_my_repo
    SELECT
        actor_login,
        sum(is_my_repo) AS stars_my,
        sum(NOT is_my_repo) AS stars_other,
        round(stars_my / (stars_my + stars_other), 3) AS ratio
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY actor_login
    ORDER BY ratio DESC
    LIMIT 10

SELECT 
    t2016.repo_name,
    t2016.stars_2016,
    t2017.stars_2017,
    (t2016.stars_2016 - t2017.stars_2017) AS decrease
FROM 
    (SELECT repo_name, count(*) AS stars_2016 
     FROM github_events 
     WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent' 
       AND created_at >= '2016-01-01' 
       AND created_at < '2017-01-01' 
     GROUP BY repo_name) AS t2016
JOIN 
    (SELECT repo_name, count(*) AS stars_2017 
     FROM github_events 
     WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent' 
       AND created_at >= '2017-01-01' 
       AND created_at < '2018-01-01' 
     GROUP BY repo_name) AS t2017
ON t2016.repo_name = t2017.repo_name
WHERE t2017.stars_2017 >= 1
ORDER BY decrease DESC
LIMIT 10

question.name: pipe_09.pipe
question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    Find the top 10 GitHub users who have the highest proportion of their stars given to repositories owned by 'javisantana' compared to all other repositories they've starred. Show each user's name, the number of stars they gave to javisantana's repos, the number of stars they gave to other repos, and the ratio of javisantana stars to total stars.

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    WITH repo_name IN
    (
        SELECT repo_name
        FROM github_events
        WHERE (event_type = 'WatchEvent') AND (actor_login IN ('javisantana'))
    ) AS is_my_repo
    SELECT
        actor_login,
        sum(is_my_repo) AS stars_my,
        sum(NOT is_my_repo) AS stars_other,
        round(stars_my / (stars_my + stars_other), 3) AS ratio
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY actor_login
    ORDER BY ratio DESC
    LIMIT 10

sql:
%
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN star_count >= 1 AND star_count < 10 THEN 1
    WHEN star_count >= 10 AND star_count < 100 THEN 10
    WHEN star_count >= 100 AND star_count < 1000 THEN 100
    WHEN star_count >= 1000 AND star_count < 10000 THEN 1000
    WHEN star_count >= 10000 AND star_count < 100000 THEN 10000
    WHEN star_count >= 100000 AND star_count < 1000000 THEN 100000
    WHEN star_count >= 1000000 AND star_count < 10000000 THEN 1000000
    WHEN star_count >= 10000000 AND star_count < 100000000 THEN 10000000
    WHEN star_count >= 100000000 AND star_count < 1000000000 THEN 100000000
    ELSE 1000000000
  END AS star_count_range,
  COUNT(repo_name) AS repo_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    repo_name,
    COUNT(actor_login) AS star_count
  FROM github_events
  WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  GROUP BY repo_name
)
GROUP BY star_count_range
ORDER BY star_count_range
LIMIT 10

SELECT
    repo_name,
    sumIf(1, toYear(created_at) = 2016) AS stars_2016,
    sumIf(1, toYear(created_at) = 2017) AS stars_2017,
    CASE
        WHEN stars_2016 = 0 THEN CAST(stars_2017, 'Float64')
        ELSE CAST((stars_2017 - stars_2016), 'Float64') / CAST(stars_2016, 'Float64')
    END AS growth_rate
FROM github_events
WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  AND created_at >= '2016-01-01'
  AND created_at < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY repo_name
HAVING stars_2016 >= 1
ORDER BY growth_rate DESC
LIMIT 10

  FROM numbers(1, 10)

sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10 AND 99 THEN 10
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100 AND 999 THEN 100
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN 1000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000 AND 99999 THEN 10000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000 AND 999999 THEN 100000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000000 AND 9999999 THEN 1000000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000000 AND 99999999 THEN 10000000
    WHEN stars >= 100000000 THEN 100000000
  END AS star_range,
  COUNT(DISTINCT repo_name) AS repo_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    repo_name,
    COUNT(*) AS stars
  FROM github_events
  WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  GROUP BY repo_name
)
GROUP BY star_range
ORDER BY star_range ASC
LIMIT 10

        repo_name,
        COUNT(*) AS stars_2016
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'

        repo_name,
        COUNT(*) AS stars_2017
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'

)

    s2017.repo_name,
    s2016.stars_2016,
    s2017.stars_2017,
    s2017.stars_2017 - s2016.stars_2016 AS absolute_growth,
    round((s2017.stars_2017 - s2016.stars_2016) * 100.0 / s2016.stars_2016, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM stars_2017 s2017
INNER JOIN stars_2016 s2016 ON s2017.repo_name = s2016.repo_name
ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC

    min(created_at) as first_star,
    max(created_at) as last_star,

    varPop(toUnixTimestamp(created_at)) / pow(avg(toUnixTimestamp(created_at)), 2) as growth_variance

    varPop(toUnixTimestamp(created_at)) / pow(avg(toUnixTimestamp(created_at)), 2) as growth_variance

WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    AND created_at >= now() - interval 365 day
GROUP BY repo_name
HAVING days_active > 30 AND total_stars > 100
ORDER BY growth_variance ASC, avg_stars_per_day DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT bucket, count(*) AS repo_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) < 10 THEN 1
            WHEN count(*) < 100 THEN 10
            WHEN count(*) < 1000 THEN 100
            WHEN count(*) < 10000 THEN 1000
            WHEN count(*) < 100000 THEN 10000
            WHEN count(*) < 1000000 THEN 100000
            WHEN count(*) < 10000000 THEN 1000000
            WHEN count(*) < 100000000 THEN 10000000
            WHEN count(*) < 1000000000 THEN 100000000
            ELSE 1000000000
        END AS bucket
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY repo_name
) AS repo_buckets
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket
LIMIT 10

sql:
SELECT
    bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS repo_count
FROM
(
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        COUNT() AS stars,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT() < 10 THEN 1
            WHEN COUNT() < 100 THEN 10
            WHEN COUNT() < 1000 THEN 100
            WHEN COUNT() < 10000 THEN 1000
            WHEN COUNT() < 100000 THEN 10000
            WHEN COUNT() < 1000000 THEN 100000
            ELSE 1000000
        END AS bucket
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY repo_name
) 
GROUP BY bucket
ORDER BY bucket ASC
LIMIT 10

question.content:
DESCRIPTION >
    For each power of 10 (1, 10, 100, 1000, etc.), count how many GitHub repositories have approximately that many stars. Order the results from smallest to largest star count

NODE endpoint
SQL >
    SELECT
        exp10(floor(log10(c))) AS stars,
        uniqExact(k)
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            repo_name AS k,
            count() AS c
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY k
    )
    GROUP BY stars

SELECT
  actor_login,
  sum(CASE WHEN repo_name LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS javisantana_stars,
  sum(CASE WHEN repo_name NOT LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_stars,
  (sum(CASE WHEN repo_name LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
   (sum(CASE WHEN repo_name LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
    sum(CASE WHEN repo_name NOT LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))
  ) AS ratio
FROM github_events
WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
GROUP BY actor_login
HAVING (sum(CASE WHEN repo_name LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
        sum(CASE WHEN repo_name NOT LIKE 'javisantana/%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

    WHEN star_count < 100 THEN 10
    WHEN star_count < 1000 THEN 100
    WHEN star_count < 10000 THEN 1000
    WHEN star_count < 100000 THEN 10000

    WHEN star_count < 1000000000 THEN 100000000

           WHEN COUNT(*) < 10000 THEN 1000

           WHEN COUNT(*) < 1000000 THEN 100000
           WHEN COUNT(*) < 10000000 THEN 1000000

SELECT
  bucket AS power_of_10,
  bucket_start,
  bucket_end,
  count(*) AS repo_count
FROM
(
  SELECT
    repo_name,
    uniq(actor_login) AS stars
  FROM github_events
  WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
  GROUP BY repo_name
)
GROUP BY
  CASE
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10 AND 99 THEN 10
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100 AND 999 THEN 100
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN 1000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000 AND 99999 THEN 10000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000 AND 999999 THEN 100000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000000 AND 9999999 THEN 1000000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000000 AND 99999999 THEN 10000000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000000 AND 999999999 THEN 100000000
    ELSE 1000000000
  END AS bucket,
  CASE
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 1
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10 AND 99 THEN 10
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100 AND 999 THEN 100
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN 1000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000 AND 99999 THEN 10000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000 AND 999999 THEN 100000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000000 AND 9999999 THEN 1000000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000000 AND 99999999 THEN 10000000
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000000 AND 999999999 THEN 100000000
    ELSE 1000000000
  END AS bucket_start,
  CASE
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1 AND 9 THEN 9
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10 AND 99 THEN 99
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100 AND 999 THEN 999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000 AND 9999 THEN 9999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000 AND 99999 THEN 99999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000 AND 999999 THEN 999999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 1000000 AND 9999999 THEN 9999999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 10000000 AND 99999999 THEN 99999999
    WHEN stars BETWEEN 100000000 AND 999999999 THEN 999999999
    ELSE 18446744073709551615
  END AS bucket_end
ORDER BY power_of_10 ASC
LIMIT 10

sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN stars >= 1 AND stars < 10 THEN 1
        WHEN stars >= 10 AND stars < 100 THEN 10
        WHEN stars >= 100 AND stars < 1000 THEN 100
        WHEN stars >= 1000 AND stars < 10000 THEN 1000
        WHEN stars >= 10000 AND stars < 100000 THEN 10000
        WHEN stars >= 100000 AND stars < 1000000 THEN 100000
        WHEN stars >= 1000000 AND stars < 10000000 THEN 1000000
        WHEN stars >= 10000000 AND stars < 100000000 THEN 10000000
        WHEN stars >= 100000000 AND stars < 1000000000 THEN 100000000
        ELSE 0
    END AS power,
    count() AS repo_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        repo_name,
        count() AS stars
    FROM github_events
    WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
    GROUP BY repo_name
)
GROUP BY power
ORDER BY power
LIMIT 10

SELECT repo_name, avg(growth_rate) AS avg_growth, stddevSamp(growth_rate) AS std_growth
FROM (
    SELECT c.repo_name, if(p.stars > 0, (c.stars - p.stars) / p.stars, NULL) AS growth_rate
    FROM (
        SELECT repo_name, toYear(created_at) AS year, toMonth(created_at) AS month, count() AS stars, (toYear(created_at)*12 + toMonth(created_at)) AS month_id
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY repo_name, year, month
    ) c
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT repo_name, toYear(created_at) AS year, toMonth(created_at) AS month, count() AS stars, (toYear(created_at)*12 + toMonth(created_at)) AS month_id
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY repo_name, year, month
    ) p ON c.repo_name = p.repo_name AND c.month_id = p.month_id + 1
)
WHERE growth_rate IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY repo_name
HAVING avg_growth > 0
ORDER BY std_growth ASC
LIMIT 10

sql:
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN stars_count < 10 THEN 1
        WHEN stars_count < 100 THEN 10
        WHEN stars_count < 1000 THEN 100
        WHEN stars_count < 10000 THEN 1000
        WHEN stars_count < 100000 THEN 10000
        WHEN stars_count < 1000000 THEN 100000

    COUNT(*) AS repo_count

DESCRIPTION >
    For each power of 10 (1, 10, 100, 1000, etc.), count how many GitHub repositories have approximately that many stars. Order the results from smallest to largest star count

NODE endpoint

    SELECT
        exp10(floor(log10(c))) AS stars,
        uniqExact(k)
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            repo_name AS k,
            count() AS c
        FROM github_events
        WHERE event_type = 'WatchEvent'
        GROUP BY k
    )
    GROUP BY stars
